tasks.short: Investigate safety complaints and record evidence, accounts and findings.

steps.what: Retrieve the safety complaints, relevant records and applicable requirements
Interview complainants and witnesses about the alleged safety violations
Examine the complained-about equipment and relevant operating conditions
Record complaint accounts, observations, evidence references and unresolved contradictions
Assess the complaint evidence and write the supported findings

tasks.design: Configure a complaint evidence view in {DOCS} and attributed investigation notes in {OPS_SYSTEM}. Keep interviews, equipment examination and findings with the inspector; native forms simplify the separate record write.
tasks.previous_blocker: Complaint records and accounts are dispersed and repeatedly entered.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked views and note fields can reduce retrieval and recording effort.
tasks.still_hard: Contradictory accounts and inaccessible equipment require investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish allegations, observations and defensible findings.

ambition.what: Identify missing evidence earlier in complaint investigations.

tasks.altitude: Give more attention to evidence quality than repeated navigation.

reach.learn: Preserve the provenance of maintenance evidence.

evidence.claim: Native evidence views and attributed note forms could reduce supporting investigation work; this is an unmeasured E1 scenario.

assumptions: This task includes interview notes and written findings. A separate formal report is priced in the reporting task, without repeating this evidence collection.

The inspector produces complaint ID, witness identity, observation time, equipment reference, evidence links and disputed points in s4, retaining 17.5 hours. Unknown facts remain explicit and are clarified manually.
Native views and forms come first. No automated violation verdict or invented approval procedure is introduced; ordinary author saves retain their incidental time.
unknowns: Accessibility of past inspection records and confidentiality restrictions.
research_questions: Does attributed note capture shorten recording without losing uncertainty or witness provenance?

already_counted.description: Capture and correct attributed complaint investigation notes.

incremental.description: Maintain evidence links and complaint note fields.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 case: B=100, R=89.5, gross=10.5, upkeep=2, net=8.5. Conservative case: fragmented legacy records leave lookup at 15 hours; a usable note form saves only three of 25 writing hours, giving R=97 and net=1. Better indexed records and fewer bespoke notes support net=5 without reducing interviews or assessment.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine corrective action, prepare notices and issue the checked final versions.

steps.what: Retrieve documented infractions, applicable requirements and previous corrective actions
Determine the supported infractions and proportionate corrective recommendations
Capture notice particulars, recommended corrections and the intended recipient
Write notices and corrective recommendations using the applicable notice template
Issue the checked final notices and recommendations to the inspected operator

tasks.design: Use linked evidence and a notice particulars form in {OPS_SYSTEM}, then complete a native notice template in {DOCS}. The inspector chooses corrective action and separately issues the exact checked notice through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Notice particulars and standard wording are repeatedly entered.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and structured particulars can simplify preparation while preserving the inspector's recommendation.
tasks.still_hard: The finding and remedy must fit the actual evidence and authority.
tasks.human_edge: Select a justified correction and communicate its exact scope.
tasks.altitude: Focus notice preparation on supported action rather than repeated wording.

reach.learn: Distinguish required corrections, deadlines and supporting findings.

evidence.claim: Native notice templates and linked findings could reduce preparation effort without choosing sanctions or corrective action.

assumptions: The recipient is an external inspected operator in this scenario. Actual notice issuance has a final-version check; internal drafting and ordinary saves have no self-approval stage.

The inspector captures case ID, operator, recipient address, finding, recommendation and deadline in s3, retaining 12 hours. Missing or disputed particulars require manual resolution before writing or sending.
The template provides headings and standard clauses; the inspector writes case-specific content. No hidden machine send, notification or sanction decision is proposed.
unknowns: Permitted notice templates, delivery channel and operator address reliability.
research_questions: How much drafting remains when notices require case-specific remedies and nonstandard clauses?

incremental.description: Maintain the applicable notice wording and particulars layout.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final notice, recommendations, deadlines, attachments and operator recipient; any change requires a renewed issue-time check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 case: B=100, R=86.5, gross=13.5; upkeep=2 gives net=11.5. Conservative case: no reusable remedy wording, full lookup and capture remain; template headings save four drafting hours, R=96 and net=2. Where standard clauses fit, nine total preparation hours saved give net=7. Issuance retains its 20 hours in both cases.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate transport incidents and violations with a traceable factual and causal record.

steps.what: Retrieve incident records, equipment history and relevant operating requirements
Inspect incident conditions and equipment failures while preserving relevant evidence
Interview personnel about delays, accidents and the sequence of events
Record incident observations, attributed accounts and evidence-linked event times
Analyse incidents and violations and write supported causal findings

tasks.design: Configure an incident evidence view and attributed event record in {OPS_SYSTEM}, linked to references in {DOCS}. Retain scene examination, interviews and causal analysis; simplify the separate lookup and record entry work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Incident records and event accounts are spread across systems and notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native evidence links and event fields can reduce repeated navigation and writing.
tasks.still_hard: An apparent sequence does not establish causation or culpability.
tasks.human_edge: Test alternative explanations against physical and testimonial evidence.

ambition.what: Identify contradictory event timings before drawing conclusions.

tasks.altitude: Keep causal judgement accountable with clearer supporting records.

reach.learn: Separate recorded defects from inferred causes.

evidence.claim: Native linked incident records and structured chronology fields could reduce supporting effort while leaving investigation and causal judgement human.

assumptions: The incident task owns its interview notes, chronology and causal findings. The complaint task covers separate complaint cases; a case that is both is investigated once. Formal report production is separately priced.

The inspector produces incident ID, source identity, observation, event time, equipment reference and uncertainty fields in s4, retaining 14 hours. Unknown timings stay unknown and are investigated manually.
Native views and forms come first. No model interprets safety evidence, assigns blame or sends findings; ordinary internal saves retain their incidental effort.
unknowns: Compatibility of incident, maintenance and operating records.
research_questions: Can linked records reduce recording time when timestamps and source identifiers differ?

already_counted.description: Enter and correct attributed event records.

incremental.description: Maintain event fields and evidence references.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 case: B=100, R=91, gross=9; upkeep=2 gives net=7. Conservative case: incompatible record identifiers leave lookup unchanged and manual chronology reconciliation leaves recording at 17 of 20 hours; R=97, net=1. Compatible identifiers with six total hours saved give net=4. Physical inspection, interviews and causal writing retain 65 hours throughout.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare evidence-linked investigation and inspection reports describing findings and actions taken.

steps.what: Select the investigation or inspection evidence and actions for the reports
Write the report outline, conclusions and source-linked action particulars
Draft the reports from the inspector's brief and selected evidence

loop.purpose: Draft report prose expressing the inspector's chosen findings.
loop.input: Written report brief and explicitly selected source passages.
loop.output: Draft prose with evidence anchors and visible gaps.
loop.check: Inspector checks each claim, attribution and action against sources and the written brief.
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported or misleading passages are written manually.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates supply headings but cannot express varied evidence and case-specific findings.

steps.what: Populate the report action table and source reference list
Check and revise the investigation reports for evidence, completeness and attribution

tasks.design: Configure linked evidence and report tables in {DOCS}, then use a bounded draft based on the inspector's written brief. Native fields assemble the action table; the inspector checks prose, source references and conclusions before completing the report.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence, action particulars and explanatory prose are repeatedly assembled into reports.
tasks.enabler_now: An explicit brief and selected source passages can constrain drafting, while native tables handle fixed fields.
tasks.still_hard: A polished narrative may overstate what an investigation established.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what findings the evidence supports and preserve uncertainty.

ambition.what: Produce a checked report format for another authorised operational audience.

tasks.altitude: Spend report effort on evidential accuracy and usable findings.

reach.learn: Distinguish established facts, actions and unresolved questions.

evidence.claim: Native report tables and source-bounded drafting could reduce report assembly; this is an E1 scenario with no measured transport inspection result.

assumptions: The task includes report preparation and ordinary internal editing. It does not introduce a new approval stage or count a same-system save as a saving. A real external issue would require its own send step and time in that workflow.

The inspector selects evidence in s1 with 16 retained hours and produces the brief plus action date, actor, action status and source ID fields in s2 with all 15 hours counted. Missing particulars stop table population and require manual correction.
The loop cannot infer new causes or recommend sanctions; unsupported passages revert to manual writing. Try native headings and tables before adding the bounded drafting loop.
Underlying investigation notes are existing inputs whose production is priced in the investigation tasks; selecting and checking their relevance is counted here.
unknowns: Report template availability, source metadata quality and permitted use of case evidence.
research_questions: Does bounded drafting reduce total report work after factual correction and attribution checks?

already_counted.description: Check and correct the source-bounded narrative draft.

incremental.description: Maintain report fields, source mappings and drafting checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 case: B=100, R=63.5, gross=36.5; upkeep=6 gives net=30.5. Conservative case: poor output metadata requires all 20 lookup hours and 10 of 15 table hours; extensive factual correction retains 30 of 35 drafting hours, so R=90 and net=4. With compatible source IDs, retaining 12 table hours and 18 drafting hours plus a four-hour lookup reduction gives R=76 and net=18. Brief writing and final report checking remain 30 hours in both cases.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep investigation and corrective judgement human while simplifying evidence retrieval and written records.
reach: Connect documented transport safety findings with clear notices and usable reports.
role.ambitious_version: A transport inspector who investigates carefully and produces traceable records, proportionate notices and clear reports.

job.title: Transportation Vehicle, Equipment and Systems Inspectors, Except Aviation
